errors.text: The proposed 750–800 °C degradation boundary is substantially above the target threshold of about 900 K, equivalent to approximately 627 °C.

The hypothesized dynamic precipitation, recrystallization, and grain-boundary-sliding mechanism does not reconstruct the target mechanism of rapid lattice disorder, reduced dislocation-line density, increased HCP fraction, and lattice softening.
The cited evidence concerns bulk compression and creep of CoCrFeMnNi rather than nanoscale friction and indentation of a 21 Å FeNiCrCoCu coating on single-crystal Cu.
The prediction of peak wear resistance at 600–700 °C conflicts with the target's sharp loss of hardness and wear resistance beginning near 900 K.
